meta.note: SYNTHETIC clinic data generated by src/generate_synthetic.py; CMS data is public.

headlines.title: Virtual visits open access faster
headlines.text: Non-acute virtual visits are booked 5.1 days out on average vs 17.0 days in person; 46.9% of in-person bookings wait more than 14 days vs 2.6% of virtual.
headlines.action: Offer a virtual slot first for chronic follow-ups when the next in-person slot is >14 days out.

headlines.title: Virtual visits cut no-shows roughly in half
headlines.text: No-show rate is 15.9% in person vs 8.6% video and 7.2% audio-only.
headlines.action: Target in-person reminder outreach at long-lead bookings, where no-shows concentrate.

headlines.title: Riverbend (C05) is the clinic to fix first
headlines.text: No-show 20.2% vs 12.6% peer average; in-person non-acute lead time 25.4 vs 15.3 days; provider utilization 63.0% vs 75.2% — about 1,119 completed visits a year below peers.
headlines.action: Open template slots and add virtual capacity at C05; review its scheduling workflow.

headlines.title: Rural patients hit a digital gap
headlines.text: Audio-only is 50.2% of rural virtual visits vs 24.6% urban, and 14.6% of rural video visits fail over to audio vs 7.3% urban.
headlines.action: Run pre-visit tech checks / device support for rural and 75+ patients before video visits.

headlines.title: Video→audio fallbacks leak revenue
headlines.text: Fallback visits are denied 20.5% of the time vs 7.3% for video and 5.6% in person ($24,507 denied), and 24.0% need an in-person visit within 14 days.
headlines.action: Add a coding check that updates modality/modifier when a video visit drops to audio.
